notes.title: The game will soon be free
notes.content:
The game will soon be free to play as I am no longer able to receive money transfers from the Steam team.
Thank!

notes.title: Fingers: Mini Games [1.02]
notes.content:
Fixes and Updates:
[list]
[*] In the game "Jenga" the basket is returned to the table at the start of the level
[*] In the game "Guess the invisible figure" added explanations to the rules of the game
[*] The panel for starting games is now larger
[*] The thumb is now smoother
[*] Grip fingers are now smoother on WMR and HTC controllers
[/list]
